faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about reporting with LikasLens.
faq.aWhatIs: LikasLens is a civic reporting platform that lets anyone report environmental issues like illegal dumping, pollution, or deforestation. Our AI automatically classifies and routes reports to the correct government agency.
faq.qIdentityProtected: Is my identity protected if I report an issue?
faq.aIdentityProtected: Yes. Turn on Ghost Mode before submitting to anonymize your report — your name, device info, and photo location data are stripped. Only the facts are sent to the authorities.
faq.qHowAiTriage: How does the AI triage system work?
faq.aHowAiTriage: When you submit a photo, our Neuro-Symbolic AI analyzes it to classify the type of violation (e.g., illegal logging, water pollution). It also detects high-risk content and may recommend Ghost Mode before submission.
faq.aAnonymousReport: Absolutely. Ghost Mode removes all personally identifiable information from your report. You don't even need to create an account — anonymous reports are accepted and processed.
faq.qAfterSubmit: What happens after I submit a report?
faq.aAfterSubmit: The report is classified by AI, assigned to the appropriate agency or NGO, and tracked through investigation to resolution. You can check your report's status on the Public Records board.
faq.aMobileApp: LikasLens is a Progressive Web App (PWA). You can install it on your phone's home screen from any browser — no app store needed. It works offline too.
faq.aReportVerification: Reports go through an AI trust-score evaluation and manual review by analysts. Verified reports are forwarded to the relevant LGU, NGO, or national agency for action.
faq.aWhoSeesReport: Resolved and verified reports are published on the Public Records board for transparency. Your identity is never shown unless you choose to submit without Ghost Mode.

architecture.title: Not a wrapper. A full neuro-symbolic pipeline.
architecture.subtitle: Six purpose-built systems working in concert. Hover any node to see what it does and why it matters.
architecture.defaultDetail: Hover any technology node on the left to see its role in the LikasLens pipeline. Each system is purpose-built, not borrowed from a template.
architecture.nodeInputDetail: Next.js 16 PWA with offline-first camera capture. EXIF metadata is stripped client-side before transmission for privacy. A SHA-256 checksum and timestamp are stored server-side for evidence integrity.
architecture.nodeYoloDetail: Custom-trained on 12,000+ Philippine environmental violation images. Detects illegal dumping, water pollution, deforestation, and 14 other violation categories with 94.6% mAP.
architecture.nodeNeuroDetail: Combines neural network outputs with symbolic logic rules derived from Philippine environmental law (RA 9003, RA 9275, RA 8749). Maps violations to exact legal statutes and penalties.
architecture.nodeGraphDetail: Neo4j graph database mapping relationships between violations, locations, agencies, statutes, and temporal patterns. Enables multi-hop queries via Cypher for pattern detection.
architecture.nodeRoutingDetail: Intelligent routing engine that maps violation types and jurisdictions to the exact government desk: DENR-EMB for industrial emissions, PCG for coastal violations, LGU for local enforcement.
architecture.nodeBackendDetail: High-performance Python 3.12 FastAPI core combined with Supabase PostgreSQL, row-level security, encrypted evidence vaults, and real-time public record synchronization.
